metadata.title: आरे जंगल के आदिवासियों पर विस्थापन का ख़तरा | Aarey Jungle tribes again in danger of displacement
metadata.description:
The Aarey Milk Colony, measuring 1,287 hectares, is located adjacent to the Sanjay Gandhi National Park. It is known as the lungs of Mumbai. In 2019, the then BJP-Shiv Sena government was looking to construct a shed at the site for its 33.5 km underground Colaba-Bandra-SEEPZ Metro project at the Aarey Milk Colony. Now, the new Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis ordered the government’s legal team to inform the Bombay High Court that the state will relocate the metro car shed to Aarey Colony. What is the Aarey Forest controversy that has the Maharashtra government and environmentalists locking horns again after nearly 2.5 years?
